description: This file defines a RegisterActivity class responsible for handling user registration UI and logic in an Android app. It manages input fields for name, phone, and password, and initiates navigation to the home screen upon registration.

classes.name: RegisterActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity handling user registration UI and logic, including input validation and navigation to the home screen.
